name: person-lookup
description: Read-only, company-filtered public professional lookup via one bounded five-result Clado people search through the SELAT Router over MPP on Tempo. Requires a full name and known current company; it does not request private contact data or send outreach.

name.description: Full professional name of the target person.

company.description: Known current employer or organization used to disambiguate the person.
